name: Link Loom: SEO Internal Link Builder
author: rivexorcom

sections.description:
Thank you for choosing Link Loom: SEO Internal Link Builder. This plugin works simply and effectively for everyone. It scans your content for keywords and automatically creates internal links that guide visitors through your site while improving SEO.

Key Features:
– Simple keyword mapping: Just enter keyword|URL pairs
– Advanced linking control: Choose which keyword occurrence to link
– Global link limits: Set fixed or random limits per page
– Smart suggestions: Get keyword and linking recommendations
– LinkMap: Discover natural linking opportunities between your pages

You have complete control over your internal linking strategy. Add as many keyword mappings as you want, choose which occurrence to link (first, last, or random), and set global limits to maintain a clean, professional look.
sections.installation:
Thank you for downloading Link Loom! Please follow these steps to get started:

  1. Automatic Installation
    – Log in to your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New
    – Search for Link Loom and click “Install Now.” Then activate the plugin.
  2. Manual Installation
    – Download the .zip file of Link Loom.
    – In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and select the .zip file.
    – Click “Install” and then activate the plugin.
  3. Settings
    – After activation, you will see a new menu item called “Link Loom” in your dashboard.
    – Click it and add your keyword mappings in the format “keyword|URL” (do not include the quotes).
    – Save your settings and your keywords will automatically be converted into internal links.
sections.faq:
How many keywords can I add?

You can add as many keywords as you want—there is no limit.

What’s the difference between the mapping formats?

  • Use “keyword|URL” for simple one-way links (do not include the quotes)
  • Use “keyword|URLto|URLfrom” to specify exactly which page links to which (do not include the quotes)

How does Link Loom choose which keywords to link?

By default, it links the first occurrence of each keyword. You can change this to last or random occurrence in the settings.

Can I control how many links appear on each page?

Yes! Set either a fixed number or a random range of links per page using the global limit settings.

Do I have to create an account to use Link Loom?

No, you do not need to register. The plugin works right away without any account.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

Link Loom is designed to be lightweight and efficient. You should not notice any performance issues.

How can I find good linking opportunities?

Use the LinkMap feature to discover keywords that naturally connect your content. It analyzes your pages and suggests relevant internal links.
